crossRefs.note: Depart! Depart! Go out from there! Touch no unclean thing! Go out from among her! Cleanse yourselves, you who carry…
“Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Go out of the land of the Chaldeans, and be as the male goats before the flocks.
“Flee out of the middle of Babylon! Everyone save his own life! Don’t be cut off in her iniquity; for it is the time of…
“My people, go away from the middle of her, and each of you save yourselves from Yahweh’s fierce anger.
Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says Yahweh; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’…
‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’
I heard another voice from heaven, saying, “Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and…
In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, Yahweh; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned…
In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah: “We have a strong city. God appoints salvation for walls and…
“Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is no other.
I have sworn by myself. The word has gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and will not be revoked, that to me every…
Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth! Break out into singing, mountains, for Yahweh has comforted his people, and will…
Break out into joy! Sing together, you waste places of Jerusalem; for Yahweh has comforted his people. He has redeemed…
Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to Yahweh, and said, “I will sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed…
‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.
When Yahweh brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.
They will come and sing in the height of Zion, and will flow to the goodness of Yahweh, to the grain, to the new wine…
Then the virgin will rejoice in the dance; the young men and the old together; for I will turn their mourning into joy…
Then the heavens and the earth, and all that is therein, will sing for joy over Babylon; for the destroyers will come…
“Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.”
After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, “Hallelujah! Salvation…
You have heard it. Now see all this. And you, won’t you declare it? “I have shown you new things from this time, even…
What one nation in the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people…
“Hear Yahweh’s word, you nations, and declare it in the distant islands. Say, ‘He who scattered Israel will gather him…
“Declare among the nations and publish, and set up a standard; publish, and don’t conceal: say, ‘Babylon has been…

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Chaldea
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian empire; known for astrology and wisdom

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! With a voice of singing announce this, tell it even to the end of the earth: say, “Yahweh has redeemed his servant Jacob!”
translations.bsb: Leave Babylon! Flee from the Chaldeans! Declare it with a shout of joy, proclaim it, let it go out to the ends of the earth, saying, “The LORD has redeemed His servant Jacob!”
translations.kjv: Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say ye, The LORD hath redeemed his servant Jacob.
translations.asv: Go ye forth from Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans; with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth: say ye, Jehovah hath redeemed his servant Jacob.
